title: Status memo: Education Funding Stabilization Act of 2026 (S. 3418)
content: S. 3418 would add $28B over four years to Title I and IDEA formula funding with a state maintenance-of-effort requirement. Reported out of the Senate HELP Committee 14-9 on July 15, 2026 (all majority members plus two minority members in favor). The majority leader, Sen. Dana Whitfield, has told leadership colleagues she wants a floor vote before the August recess and has penciled floor time in the week of August 3. Cloture requires 60 votes. The public whip situation as of July 24: 49 senators publicly committed or reliably counted yes (the 47-member majority caucus minus one holdout, plus 3 minority members who voted for it in committee or endorsed it publicly), 41 publicly no or leaning no, 10 publicly undecided. Among the undecided are 4 minority-party appropriators who have asked for a state flexibility amendment on the maintenance-of-effort rule. The one majority holdout, Sen. Rual Ortiz, wants a rural broadband set-aside added and has said he is 'a likely yes' if it is included.

title: Senate floor calendar and procedure notes
content: The Senate is in session through Friday August 7, 2026; the August state work period begins August 10 and runs through September 7. The week of July 27 is committed to judicial nominations and the annual defense authorization. If cloture on the motion to proceed to S. 3418 is filed Monday August 3, the earliest realistic cloture vote is Wednesday August 5, with final passage (if cloture succeeds and time agreements hold) by Friday August 7. Absent a time agreement, a single objecting senator can push final passage past the recess. Amendment negotiations (the state-flexibility amendment and the rural broadband set-aside) are being brokered by the bill manager, Sen. Maura Kelly; both amendments have draft text and neither raises a new budget point of order per the CBO letter of July 21. If the bill does not pass before the recess, leadership aides say floor time in September is not guaranteed given appropriations deadlines.
